mapper.select: /** * searchComboItem : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMngMapper : 수령장비구분코드 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD' /** 수령장비구분코드 **/
mapper.update: /** * updateRcivEqptIndtyMng1 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMngMapper : 기자재수령내역 수정 */ MERGE INTO AYC331 AA /** 기자재 수령내역 **/ USING DUAL ON ( AA.RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN = #{indexSn} AND AA.RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD = #{eqpSeCd} /**수령장비 구분코드**/ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( AA.RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN , AA.RECPT_EQPMNT_SE_CD , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{indexSn} , #{eqpSeCd} , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: /** * deleteRciveEqptIndtyMng1 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMngMapper : 기자재수령내역 삭제 */ DELETE FROM AYC331 AA /** 기자재 수령내역 **/ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.RECPT_EQPMNT_CNFRMN_SN = #{indexSn}
mapper.update:
/** * deleteRciveEqptIndtyMng : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.RcivEqptIndtyMngMapper : 기자재수령확인서 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC330 AA /** 사이버1388 장비 **/ SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE
WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{indexSn}
